sentences.en: And you saw opponents taking to the streets almost immediately and organizing a rally in opposition.
sentences.zh: 你看到反对者几乎立即走上街头，组织了一场抗议集会。

sentences.en: And what exactly is the basis for this immediate opposition?
sentences.zh: 那么这种立即反对的基础到底是什么？

sentences.en: The opposition is coming from three different directions.
sentences.zh: 反对声音来自三个不同的方向。

sentences.en: There are unions that are opposed to Amazon for their labor practices, not just in New York
sentences.zh: 有些工会反对亚马逊的劳工行为，不仅是在纽约

sentences.en: City, but around the country and really around the world.
sentences.zh: 市，而且在全国乃至全世界。

sentences.en: And they see Amazons coming to New York as an opportunity to make the point that this is a vast workforce of more than a half million people and there are no unionized labor.
sentences.zh: 他们将亚马逊进驻纽约视为一个机会，以此强调这是一个拥有超过50万人的庞大劳动力群体，却没有工会组织。

sentences.en: And so that's one bucket.
sentences.zh: 所以这是第一类。

sentences.en: The second bucket consists of local groups that looked at this arrival of Amazon not as a boon, but as a burden.
sentences.zh: 第二类由当地团体组成，他们看待亚马逊的到来不是作为一种福音，而是一种负担。

sentences.en: That this was really going to hurt the community that it was coming to.
sentences.zh: 这真的会伤害到它即将入驻的社区。

sentences.en: It was going to increase cost of living, increase housing prices.
sentences.zh: 它会导致生活成本增加，房价上涨。

sentences.en: It was going to burden the 7 train.
sentences.zh: 它会给7号线带来负担。

sentences.en: The 7 train being the local subway that goes out to Long Island City.
sentences.zh: 7号线就是那条通往长岛市的本地地铁线路。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so folks were concerned what this would actually do to the neighborhood that it was going to land in.
sentences.zh: 所以人们担心这会对它即将落户的社区产生什么实际影响。

sentences.en: And then you had a third group that was worried that the tax incentives and the other sorts of subsidies that were being given to this company should not be given because this
sentences.zh: 然后还有第三类人，他们担心给予这家公司的税收优惠和其他各类补贴不应该发放，因为这

sentences.en: is the most valuable company in the world run by the richest person in the world.
sentences.zh: 是世界上最有价值的公司，由世界上最富有的人经营。

sentences.en: And they don't need billions of dollars of city and state money.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不需要几十亿美元的市级和州级资金。

sentences.en: And how big is the package of tax incentives?
sentences.zh: 那么税收优惠方案有多大？

sentences.en: What does it consist of?
sentences.zh: 它包含哪些内容？

sentences.en: And what is the logic of the tax incentives?
sentences.zh: 税收优惠的逻辑又是什么？

sentences.en: So the total package was nearly $3 billion for creating these 25 to 40,000 jobs.
sentences.zh: 总方案金额接近30亿美元，用于创造这2.5万到4万个就业岗位。

sentences.en: The one sort of direct subsidy was a cash grant to Amazon for constructing their headquarters.
sentences.zh: 其中一种直接补贴是给亚马逊建设总部的现金拨款。

sentences.en: It was going to be $500 million.
sentences.zh: 金额为5亿美元。

sentences.en: And the rest of it was going to come in the form of tax credits.
sentences.zh: 其余部分将以税收抵免的形式提供。

sentences.en: And these were going to be given to Amazon in exchange for creating jobs.
sentences.zh: 这些抵免将作为创造就业的回报给予亚马逊。

sentences.en: And so if they created a job, they got the tax break.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们创造了一个岗位，就能获得税收减免。

sentences.en: And if they didn't create the job, they didn't get the tax break.
sentences.zh: 如果他们没有创造岗位，就拿不到税收减免。

sentences.en: And so the mayor was very adamant that these were the kinds, at least on the city side, these were the kinds of breaks that any company that moved to that particular area of Queens
sentences.zh: 市长非常坚持认为，至少在市政府层面，这些减免是任何搬迁到皇后区特定区域的公司

sentences.en: was entitled to.
sentences.zh: 都有权获得的。

sentences.en: The fact that Amazon was promising to bring so many jobs meant that the tax break was going to be huge.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊承诺带来如此多的就业岗位，意味着税收减免额度将非常巨大。

sentences.en: So the opposition is stemming, in summary, from unions who fear what Amazon will do to the future of work and organized labor in New York, people who are worried about being priced
sentences.zh: 总而言之，反对意见源于工会，他们担心亚马逊会对纽约未来的工作和有组织劳工产生影响；源于担心被挤出

sentences.en: out of this neighborhood in Queens, where the headquarters will be located, and objections to the size of this tax deal to lure the company.
sentences.zh: 皇后区这个总部所在地的人们；以及对吸引该公司所提供的税收协议规模的反对。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to some degree, that was entirely expected by the political leaders in New York City and New York State.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，纽约市和纽约州的政治领导人完全预料到了这一点。

sentences.en: It was common for this sort of deal to see that kind of opposition, you know, in a city like
sentences.zh: 在像纽约这样的城市，看到这种反对声音是很常见的，

sentences.en: New York, but what no one could have anticipated was a political chain reaction that was going
sentences.zh: 但没有人能预料到会引发一场政治连锁反应，

sentences.en: to be set off when a young, sort of out-of-nowhere candidate who was progressive, who was liberal,
sentences.zh: 当一位年轻的、半路杀出的进步派候选人，一位自由派，

sentences.en: who had been a bartender, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who ousted one of the most powerful people
sentences.zh: 曾做过酒保的亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯，击败了国会中最有权势的人之一，
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: in Congress from the district just adjacent to where Amazon was thinking of locating its headquarters.
sentences.zh: 而选区就在亚马逊考虑设立总部的地方旁边。

sentences.en: And what that did was essentially embolden Democrats in general to think that they could take on some of the entrenched powers within the party and outside it.
sentences.zh: 这在本质上鼓舞了民主党人，让他们认为自己可以挑战党内和党外的一些既得利益者。

sentences.en: And so what you saw then in November was not only victories in New York, flipping the state
sentences.zh: 所以你在11月看到的不仅是纽约的胜利，让州参议院

sentences.en: Senate into Democratic hands, but you saw all these House races going to young, much more left-of-center candidates.
sentences.zh: 转为民主党控制，还看到所有这些众议院竞选都由年轻、更偏左的候选人获胜。

sentences.en: So suddenly when Amazon announces that they're coming to Queens a few days after the election
sentences.zh: 所以当亚马逊在11月选举几天后宣布他们要来皇后区时，

sentences.en: in November, they're now facing a sort of rejuvenated left who were energized and who had organizing infrastructure, the lists that they had, the supporters, and they used that
sentences.zh: 他们面对的是一个重振旗鼓的左翼阵营，他们充满活力，拥有组织架构、名单和支持者，他们利用这些

sentences.en: to fan out across this area of Queens and be very visible.
sentences.zh: 在皇后区这一带散开，并表现得非常高调。

sentences.en: And so the opponents were the loudest voices and they were on the streets really hustling to say, this is not good for us.
sentences.zh: 所以反对者成了最响亮的声音，他们走上街头，极力呼喊：这对我们没好处。

sentences.en: It took Amazon and the city sort of a while to realize that this opposition had any kind of legs to it.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊和市政府花了一段时间才意识到这种反对意见是有根基的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm going to begin the hearing.
sentences.zh: 我要开始听证会了。

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Then you had the first city council hearing in December of last year, and nothing in the agreement needed Amazon to appear there.
sentences.zh: 去年12月举行了第一次市议会听证会，协议中没有任何条款要求亚马逊必须出席。

sentences.en: But we don't see this just as an investment.
sentences.zh: 但我们不仅仅将其视为一项投资。

sentences.en: We've made specific commitments already, and we will be joining with our neighbors to advocate for the future of Long Island City.
sentences.zh: 我们已经做出了具体承诺，并将与我们的邻居携手，为长岛市的未来而努力。

sentences.en: But they were counseled and agreed that, you know, in order to smooth the sort of political
sentences.zh: 但他们接受了建议并同意，为了平息政治上的

sentences.en: rough patches, it would be good to appear in public and talk about the deal and that they felt they could sell it.
sentences.zh: 摩擦，公开露面谈论这项协议并表示他们有信心说服公众是件好事。

sentences.en: And it was a big disaster.
sentences.zh: 结果却是一场大灾难。

sentences.en: Hey, please, everyone, please.

sentences.zh: 我再给一次警告。

sentences.zh: 第一次市议会听证会现场挤满了反对者，他们高喊口号，甚至用一些亵渎的语言辱骂他们。

sentences.en: G-T-F-O, Amazon.
sentences.zh: 滚出这里，亚马逊。

sentences.en: Folks, I'm going to give one more warning.
sentences.zh: 各位，我再给一次警告。

sentences.en: Dropped a banner.
sentences.zh: 扔下了一条横幅。

sentences.en: What did the banner say?
sentences.zh: 横幅上写了什么？

sentences.zh: 横幅上巧妙地改造了亚马逊的标志，通常是一个笑脸。

sentences.en: And they took it, and in the exact same sort of design, made it a frowny face and looked quite angry.
sentences.zh: 他们采用了完全相同的设计，把它变成了一个哭脸，看起来非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And the Amazon executives weren't ready for this.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊的高管们对此毫无准备。

sentences.zh: 他们看起来很动摇。

sentences.en: And Amazon is a $1 trillion company.
sentences.zh: 而亚马逊是一家万亿美元级别的公司。

sentences.en: Is that accurate?
sentences.zh: 这准确吗？

sentences.en: They had no supporters among the city council members who were questioning them.
sentences.zh: 在质询他们的市议会议员中，他们没有得到任何支持。

sentences.en: Close to that.
sentences.zh: 差不多。

sentences.en: So why should we give you this money?
sentences.zh: 那么我们为什么要给你们这笔钱？

sentences.en: So these incentives, they're performing.
sentences.zh: 这些激励措施，它们是有成效的。

sentences.en: And they left in a huff after that.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他们气冲冲地离开了。

sentences.en: And then there's a second meeting a month later, and it doesn't go much better for Amazon.
sentences.zh: 一个月后举行了第二次会议，对亚马逊来说情况并没有好转。

sentences.en: And in fact, they say on the record during this hearing, something that is horrible to unions and most elected officials here.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们在听证会上公开表示了一些让工会和大多数民选官员感到震惊的话。

sentences.zh: 如果亚马逊的员工想要成立工会，你们会同意保持中立吗？

sentences.zh: 不，先生。

sentences.en: We respect it.
sentences.zh: 我们尊重这一点。

sentences.en: You wouldn't agree to that.
sentences.zh: 你们不会同意这一点。

sentences.en: Correct, sir.
sentences.zh: 没错，先生。

sentences.en: We would not.
sentences.zh: 我们不会。

sentences.en: They're going to actively work to prevent unionization in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他们将积极采取行动阻止纽约市的工会化。

sentences.en: So after that, you have a series of events culminating in the state Senate, which has recently gone into Democratic hands in the last election, delivering a win for opponents.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，发生了一系列事件，最终在最近一次选举中转为民主党控制的州参议院，为反对者带来了胜利。

sentences.en: They select a vocal critic in Queens to an essential board that had the power to veto this whole deal.
sentences.zh: 他们任命了一位皇后区的直言不讳的批评者进入一个关键委员会，该委员会有权否决整个协议。

sentences.en: So things are definitively not going great for Amazon in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以亚马逊在纽约的情况绝对不妙。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But still, nobody really thinks that this is going to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，没人真的认为这会彻底告吹。

sentences.en: I mean, you still had the powerful governor of New York on the side of Amazon and the mayor of New York, who's a self-described progressive backing it and making the argument
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你仍然有强大的纽约州州长站在亚马逊一边，还有自称进步派的纽约市长也在支持它，并从那个角度

sentences.en: for it from that perspective.
sentences.zh: 为它辩护。

sentences.en: And so there's a feeling that this would be some rough waters, but that they would get through it.
sentences.zh: 所以人们觉得这虽然会经历一些波折，但他们最终能挺过去。

sentences.en: And then what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So I'm on my way to work last Thursday, and I get a call from someone who tells me about a union meeting that's happened between Amazon officials orchestrated by the governor.
sentences.zh: 上周四我在上班路上，接到一个人的电话，告诉我关于一场由州长策划的亚马逊官员与工会之间的会议。

sentences.en: And it seems as if there's actually progress towards some kind of deal that they're going to maybe not make concessions, but have some terms where they could talk to the unions.
sentences.zh: 看起来似乎在达成某种协议方面取得了进展，他们可能不会做出让步，但会有一些条款让他们可以与工会对话。

sentences.en: And this seemed like, oh, this is how the supporters are going to get through this.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是，哦，这就是支持者们解决问题的方式。

sentences.en: So I arrive at work.
sentences.zh: 所以我到了公司。

sentences.en: I think this is my story for the day.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我当天的报道内容。

sentences.en: I'm going to figure, you know, write how the supporters are actually gaining an edge here.
sentences.zh: 我想写写支持者们是如何在这里占据上风的。

sentences.en: And then I get a phone call, and it's someone who has direct knowledge of what's going on in the Amazon deal.
sentences.zh: 然后我接到了一个电话，对方直接了解亚马逊交易的内情。

sentences.en: And they say, I can't believe I'm saying this, but it's over.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我不敢相信我正在说这些，但一切都结束了。

sentences.en: They're leaving.

sentences.en: And it was a complete shock to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说完全是晴天霹雳。

sentences.en: It was probably the most shocking call I've gotten in my journalistic life.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我新闻生涯中接到过最令人震惊的电话。

sentences.en: And so I just got up with the cell phone still in my ear, and I walked over to our Metro editor, Cliff Levy, and I said, they're pulling out.

sentences.en: Amazon's leaving.

sentences.en: And he was also shocked.
sentences.zh: 他也感到震惊。

sentences.en: And everyone starts in motion.
sentences.zh: 每个人都开始行动起来。

sentences.en: And then I get back to my desk, and I get a second call from someone else who thought they were actually bringing me the story.

sentences.en: And the favorite expression was that they took their ball and went home.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以关于他们为什么要这样做有各种各样的理论，但都归结为一个想法，即亚马逊真的不想与纽约人对话，倾听他们的担忧

sentences.en: And so there was all kinds of theories about why they would do so, but they all came back to this idea that Amazon really didn't want to talk to New Yorkers and hear their concerns
sentences.zh: 并以某种有意义的方式解决这些问题。

sentences.en: and address them in some meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 也许他们参加了市议会听证会，但他们并没有带着任何提议回来。

sentences.en: Maybe they went to a city council hearing, but they didn't come back with any kind of offers.
sentences.zh: 当他们在政治上遇到困难时，他们没有尝试谈判并寻找出路。

sentences.en: And then when things got tough for them politically, they didn't try and negotiate and find a way out.
sentences.zh: 他们直接离开了。

sentences.en: They simply left.
sentences.zh: 这对大多数习惯并期待某种程度对话的纽约人来说是冒犯性的。

sentences.en: And that was offensive to most people in New York City who are used to and expect some level of dialogue.
sentences.zh: 一直以来，反对者都觉得纽约市并不像亚马逊需要纽约市那样需要亚马逊。

sentences.en: All along, opponents felt like New York City didn't need Amazon as much as Amazon needed
sentences.zh: 这就是他们说这些激励措施太多的理由。

sentences.en: New York City.
sentences.zh: 我们从公司那里得到的还不够多。

sentences.en: And that was their argument for saying, these incentives are too much.
sentences.zh: 最终，亚马逊对纽约说，我们并不像你们想象的那样需要你们。

sentences.en: We're not getting enough from the company.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就离开了。

sentences.en: And in the end, it turned out that Amazon said to New York, we don't really need you as much as you think we do.
sentences.zh: 那么归根结底，像纽约这样的地方，这种规模的项目崩溃会有什么后果？

sentences.en: And they left.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，在经济层面这不会是什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: So ultimately, what are the consequences of a project of this scale in a place like New
sentences.zh: 当然，失去2.5万个就业岗位确实会有影响。

sentences.en: York collapsing?
sentences.zh: 但纽约是一个在短短几个月内就能常规性创造数万个就业岗位的城市。

sentences.en: Strangely, it won't be that big a deal on the economic front.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, obviously, losing 25,000 jobs is something that has an effect.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是什么大问题。

sentences.en: But New York is a place where tens of thousands of jobs are generated in the span of a few months routinely.
sentences.zh: 这只是纽约日常运作的一部分。

sentences.en: But with those jobs, there was going to be tax revenue that came.
sentences.zh: 但有了这些工作岗位，随之而来的将是税收收入。

sentences.en: In fact, the state had estimated that if all the jobs they proposed had come, the city would have given up $3 billion in incentives in this grant and would have gotten $27 billion
sentences.zh: 事实上，州政府曾估算，如果他们提议的所有工作岗位都能落实，市政府将在这项拨款中放弃30亿美元的激励措施，但会获得270亿美元

sentences.en: back in revenue.
sentences.zh: 的税收回报。

sentences.en: And so this is a nine-to-one equation is what policymakers said.
sentences.zh: 所以政策制定者所说的就是一个九比一的等式。

sentences.en: And that's not an insignificant amount of money.
sentences.zh: 这可不是一笔小数目。

sentences.en: It could go a long way to fixing up the subway system and a myriad of other needs that the city has.
sentences.zh: 它可以在修复地铁系统以及满足城市其他诸多需求方面发挥很大作用。

sentences.en: But the bigger impact of this decision is around the kind of deal that happened here.
sentences.zh: 但这一决定更大的影响在于这里所达成的协议类型。

sentences.en: This is an economic development deal that was bigger than the ones that we've seen before, but was essentially something that was familiar to people.
sentences.zh: 这是一项比我们以往所见规模更大的经济发展协议，但本质上对人们来说并不陌生。

sentences.en: A company comes in, promises to do something.
sentences.zh: 一家公司入驻，承诺做些什么。

sentences.en: Politicians are glad to have the company come in, and everyone goes home happy.
sentences.zh: 政客们乐于见到公司入驻，大家都皆大欢喜。

sentences.en: And the fact that not only were people unhappy here, but the unhappy folks won the day says
sentences.zh: 事实上，不仅人们在这里感到不满，而且这些不满的人最终还赢了，这说明了

sentences.en: something about where this country is right now in terms of our relationship with corporations, our ability to effect change through grassroots organizing.
sentences.zh: 当今这个国家在与企业关系方面，以及我们通过基层组织实现变革的能力方面，正处于一个什么样的境地。

sentences.en: For businesses like Amazon, this means that they can't any longer assume that they're going to be welcomed with open arms in especially the big cities that they come to.
sentences.zh: 对于像亚马逊这样的企业来说，这意味着他们不能再理所当然地认为，自己来到大城市时一定会受到热烈欢迎。

sentences.en: And with giant tax packages.
sentences.zh: 而且还带着巨额的税收优惠方案。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, they may have to make concessions and be open to conversations that they really don't want to have and don't expect to have right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们可能不得不做出让步，并对那些他们目前并不想进行、也不期望进行的对话持开放态度。

sentences.en: But what seems to be the bigger effect of this is on the political side.
sentences.zh: 但这件事似乎更大的影响是在政治层面。

sentences.en: I think it's incredible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I mean, it shows that everyday Americans still have the power to organize and fight for their communities.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这表明普通美国人仍然有能力组织起来，为自己的社区而战。

sentences.en: And they can have more say in this country than the richest man in the world.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个国家，他们比世界上最富有的人拥有更多的话语权。

sentences.en: Where you have some Democrats, and most prominently Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez,
sentences.zh: 你看到一些民主党人，最突出的是亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯，
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: hearing Amazon backing out as a win.
sentences.zh: 将亚马逊的退出视为一场胜利。

sentences.en: And that creates, for Republicans, a ready-made talking point.
sentences.zh: 这为共和党人创造了一个现成的谈资。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the message that they've wanted to deliver to attack Democrats for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是他们长期以来一直想用来攻击民主党人的信息。

sentences.en: These are job killers.
sentences.zh: 这些人是就业杀手。

sentences.en: These are people who don't support business and will undermine the efforts to help communities grow.
sentences.zh: 这些人不支持商业，会破坏帮助社区发展的努力。

sentences.en: For Democrats, it's much more split and hard to know how to go forward.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党人来说，党内分歧很大，很难知道该如何前进。

sentences.en: Because it's hard to argue in the middle of the country where places are hungering for jobs that opposing corporations who want to bring jobs to a place is the right message
sentences.zh: 因为在中部地区，人们渴望就业，很难论证反对那些想要带来就业机会的企业是正确的口号，

sentences.en: for a 2020 candidate.
sentences.zh: 对于2020年的候选人来说。

sentences.en: At the same time, the energized part of the base in urban areas where the Democratic Party is strongest are voters who feel that the cost of living is too high, corporations have
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在民主党实力最强的城市地区，其核心选民群体感到生活成本太高，企业拥有

sentences.en: too much power, and we shouldn't just be handing over the keys to cities to different corporations and the wealthy that want to play there.
sentences.zh: 太大的权力，我们不应该仅仅把城市的主导权交给那些想在这里捞钱的企业和富人。

sentences.en: And so I think the argument for Democrats is going to be much more difficult to make than
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，民主党人要提出这一论点将比共和党人困难得多，

sentences.en: Republicans, and it's going to be very difficult for Democrats to make outside of the urban centers and the coasts.
sentences.zh: 而且民主党人在城市中心和沿海地区之外很难推行这一观点。

sentences.en: So this could end up coming back to haunt the Democrats, perhaps not right away, but maybe in 2020, at the presidential level, maybe beyond.
sentences.zh: 所以这最终可能会反过来困扰民主党人，也许不是马上，但可能在2020年的总统大选层面，甚至更久之后。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: David, what is Amazon going to do now that the second half of this second headquarters is not going to be in New York?
sentences.zh: 大卫，既然第二个总部的一半不会设在纽约，亚马逊现在打算做什么？

sentences.en: One thing they've said they're not going to do is start a new search.
sentences.zh: 他们说的一件事是，他们不会开始新的选址搜索。

sentences.en: They're done with the public nationwide searching.
sentences.zh: 他们已经结束了全国范围的公开搜索。

sentences.en: Kind of bruised by the experience.
sentences.zh: 这次经历让他们有点受挫。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It didn't go well for them, at least in New York City.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说并不顺利，至少在纽约市是这样。

sentences.en: And they've said instead that they're going to grow in the places that they already are.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，相反，他们将在已经入驻的地方进行扩张。

sentences.en: And that means the suburbs of Virginia, Nashville, and Seattle.
sentences.zh: 这意味着弗吉尼亚州、纳什维尔和西雅图的郊区。

sentences.en: And also, they're in New York City.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们也还在纽约市。

sentences.en: They have about 5,000 employees who already work here.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里已经有大约5000名员工。

sentences.en: And they vowed to grow that number.
sentences.zh: 他们誓言要增加这个数字。

sentences.en: And so you can imagine that over the course of a few years, they'll have 10,000 people working here.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，几年之后，他们在这里将有10000名员工。

sentences.en: Maybe one day they'll have 15,000 people.
sentences.zh: 也许有一天他们会有15000人。

sentences.en: Maybe they'll even get up to 25,000 people at some point.
sentences.zh: 也许在某个时候他们甚至会达到25000人。

sentences.en: The same number that they would have dropped into Long Island City in this deal put together by the company and elected officials here.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们原本打算通过公司与当地民选官员达成的协议，投入到长岛市的员工人数。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they won't have gotten a dime of tax incentives to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且他们这样做将一分钱的税收优惠都拿不到。

sentences.en: David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me on here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来这里。
